content: तीक्ष्ण {%a.%} [तिज्-क्स्न <ls>Uṇ. 3. 18.</ls>] .²1 Sharp (in all senses), pungent; तीक्ष्णा नारुंतुदा बुद्धिः <ls>Śi. 2. 109</ls>. .²2 Hot, warm (as rays); विवस्वता तीक्ष्णतरांशुमालिना <ls>Ṛs. 1. 18</ls>. .²3 Fiery, passionate. .²4 Hard, forcible, strong (as उपाय); आश्रयो धार्तराष्ट्राणां मानी तीक्ष्णपराक्रमः <ls>Mb. 12. 1. 20</ls>. .²5 Rude, cross. .²6 Severe, harsh, rough, strict; तीक्ष्णश्चैव मृदुश्च स्यात्कार्यं वीक्ष्य महीपतिः <ls>Ms. 7. 140</ls>. .²7 Injurious, inauspicious. .²8 Keen. .²9 Intelligent, clever. .²10 Zealous, vehement, energetic. .²11 Devoted, self-abandoning. .²12 Unfriendly, unfavourable. .²13 Devout, ascetic, pious. .{@-क्ष्णः@} .²1 Nitre. .²2 Long pepper. .²3 Black pepper. .²4 Black mustard. .{@-क्ष्णम्@} .²1 Iron. .²2 Steel. .²3 Heat, pungency. .²4 War, battle. .²5 Poison. .²6 Death. .²7 A weapon. .²8 Sea-salt. .²9 Haste. .²10 Anything sharp (as words <ab>&c.</ab>). .²11 Plague, pestilence.
